summary: The persistence receipt (CheckRun 8fe903524f22467093335791ab4c1afe) established only its control: in the round without a forged message the retried pre-vote produced no response (index 29). The persistence comparison came out unknown because one admission alias bound to a single round can only correlate that round's result, so the round-1 and round-2 outcomes (indices 32, 35) were marked as missing prerequisites and the lone valid witness was discarded for lack of independence; the raw events do show the predicted pattern (each round restores lead by heartbeat, clears it, grants again, leader stays StateLeader at term 2) but I recorded those as uncited observations rather than counting them. Conclusion and defect_claim are therefore unresolved for this child question, and the requested successor of the same fixed experiment re-wires it per round: one admission alias per round (p_forget_r1/r2/r3) and single-round persistence comparisons plus single-round repair comparisons, so no comparison spans uncorrelatable rounds. Validation passed with the execution requested; the persistence claim remains open until that receipt arrives.
